articles.title: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences Museum Closes as Supporters Seek Reopening
articles.summary: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences Museum closed on September 30. A foundation offered a year of temporary funding, but reopening would require a plan to pay costs over time.

articles.title: Trump Urges Calls to Senator Cotton Over Daylight Saving Time
articles.summary: Trump urged Americans to contact Senator Tom Cotton about keeping daylight saving time all year. Cotton opposes the plan, citing darker winter mornings for children going to school.

articles.title: Nearly 1,400 Workers Lose Jobs at an Ohio Truck Factory
articles.summary: Nearly 1,400 workers were laid off at a truck factory in Springfield, Ohio, on September 30. The Dayton region has also attracted aerospace businesses after years of declining factory employment.
